newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.9 Dec 27 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.9 Dec 27 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 105.9 in the week ended December 27 from a revised 105.6 the previous week, ECRI said.
The growth rate of real estate loans rose and the yield spread between 10-year and three-month Treasuries narrowed, leading to the rise in the index, ECRI said.

"The gauge shows the underlying inflationary and disinflationary forces (are) well-balanced right now, with relative tightness in the labor markets offset by slack in the other leading inflation indicators," it said.
